articles.title: Vistry Group (LSE:VTY) Stock Fair Value Moves Lower After Analyst Target Cuts
articles.summary: Vistry Group is back in focus after fair value estimates were cut from £5.18 to about £3.15 and several analyst price targets reset into a tighter range between roughly £2.10 and £3.40. Those revised targets, including more upbeat views clustered around £2.63 to £2.70, reflect fresh debate on how current margins, incentive use and cash generation compare with what the share price already prices in.
